dedupe_keys.name: wind tunnel experimental dataset for wind farm control with scanning lidar wake measurements

description: A Technical University of Munich team releases controlled wind-tunnel measurements from three scaled turbines. Zenodo provides a public archive, test matrix and README under CC BY 4.0. The provider describes scanning-lidar wake velocities, inflow references, yaw and pitch settings, turbine power, hub and tower loads, with 250 Hz operational signals and 2.5 kHz load signals in NetCDF4 experiments. These measurements can calibrate wake-control, reduced-order flow or structural-load simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment collection. A limitation is that scaled tunnel wakes and controlled inflow cannot be treated as measured performance of a full offshore wind farm. The README refers to `Single Wake.zip`, whereas the public file inventory lists `Multiple Wake.zip`; the experiments inside were not checked. The test matrix is said to map conditions to files, but its rows and experiment count were not independently verified. No archive or workbook was downloaded, and no wake or power response was reproduced.
